verses.en: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.sm: Heperona; o le ulumatua o Amanono le tama a Ainoama o le Isereelu; o lona toalua, o Tanielu le tama a Apikaila le Karamelu;

verses.en: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.sm: o le toatolu, o Apisaloma le tama a Maaka, o le afafine o Talemai le tupu o Kasuri; o le toafa, o Atonia le tama a Hakita;

verses.en: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.sm: o le toalima, o Sefatia le tama a Apitala; o le toaono, o Itereamu le tama a Ekeli lana ava.

verses.en: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.sm: O le toaono ia na fanau ia te ia i Heperona; na fai ai O ia ma tupu i tausaga e fitu ma masina e ono; na tupu foi o ia i Ierusalema i tausaga e tolu sefulu ma le tolu.

verses.en: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.sm: O i latou nei foi na fanau ia te ia i Ierusalema; o Sama, ma Sopapa, ma Natano, ma Solomona, e toafa, o tama a Patesua, o le afafine o Amueli.

verses.en: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.sm: O Ivara foi, ma Elisama, ma Elifaleta,

verses.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.sm: ma Nokaa, ma Nefeku, ma lafia,

verses.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.sm: ma Elisama, ma Eliata; ma Elifaleta, ua toaiva ia.

verses.en: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.sm: O atalii uma ia o Tavita, a ua le faitauina o tama a palake; o Tamara foi o lo latou tuafafine.

verses.en: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.sm: O le atalii foi o Solomona o Reopoamo, o lona atalii o Avia, o lona atalii o Asa, o lona atalii o losefatu,

verses.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.sm: o lona atalii o lorama, o lona atalii o Aasaia, o lona atalii o Ioasa,

verses.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.sm: o lona araw o Amasia, o lona atalii o Asaraia, o lona atalii o Iotama,

verses.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.sm: o lona atalii o Aasa, o lona atalii o Esekia, o lona atalii o Manase,

verses.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.sm: o lona atalii o Amone, o lona atalii o Iosia.

verses.en: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Iosia, o le ulumatua o Iokana o le toalua o loakima, o le toatolu o Setekaia, o le toafa o Saluma.

verses.en: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Ioakima, o lona atalii o Iekonia, o lona atalii o Setekaia.

verses.en: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.sm: O atalii o Iekonia o Esara o lona atalii o Salatielu,

verses.en: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.sm: o Malekirama foi, ma Petaia, ma Senasara, o Iokamia, o Hosama, ma Netavia.

verses.en: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.sm: O atalii o Petaia o Serupapelu, ma Semi; o atalii o Serupapelu, o Mesulama, ma Hanania, atoa ma Salome lo latou tuafafine,

verses.en: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.sm: ma Kasopa, ma Oelu, ma Perekia, ma Kasatia, ma lusapa-keseta, ua toalima ia.

verses.en: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Hanania; o Peletia ma Isaia; o atalii o Refaia, o atalii o Arinona, o atalii o Opetaia, o atalii o Sekania.

verses.en: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Sekania, o Semaia; O araw o Semaia; o Hatusa, ma Ikalo, ma Parea, ma Nearia, ma Safata, ua toaono ia.

verses.en: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Nearia; o Elioenai, ma Esekia, ma Aserikama, ua toatolu ia.

verses.en: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Elioenai; o Hotaia, ma Eliasipa, ma Pelaia, ma Akopa, ma Iokana, ma Talaia, ma Anani, ua toafitu ia. O gafa 0 Iuta ma
